name: Eleanor Davies
bio:
Eleanor Davies's journey into motorsport security began unexpectedly. After a brief stint in the Metropolitan Police, she found the intensity and technical demands of Formula racing more stimulating than patrol duty. A chance encounter at a Silverstone race led to an opportunity within a small privateer team, where she quickly proved her mettle in managing not only trackside security but also the increasingly complex logistical challenges of protecting valuable equipment and intellectual property. 

Her approach is meticulously detail-oriented, recognizing that in motorsport, a single lapse in security can have catastrophic consequences. She prioritizes threat assessment and proactive measures, ensuring her team is always one step ahead. Eleanor distinguishes herself through her calm demeanor under pressure, a trait honed through years of high-stakes situations. She is also valued for her ability to integrate cutting-edge technology into security protocols.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Eleanor is of average height and build, with a focused and analytical gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with security protocols and risk assessments.
Has an uncanny ability to remember faces and names, even after brief encounters.
Insists on checking every security camera feed at least once per shift.
